No node for Christmas, Halloween, Diwali, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, Eid, or Ramadan anywhere in this taxonomy. As a secondary check (not proof of absence per se, used only alongside the nav audit) ran the site's own SSR internal search: 'christmas' -> 0 results ('No results found for "christmas"'); 'ramadan' -> 1 result, a single SKU 'Zahra Ramadan Door Decor' with no dedicated Ramadan category page (its own PDP now 404s, i.e. delisted, and it was never linked from any category node); 'eid' -> 5 results that are generic fuzzy-match noise unrelated to Eid (sofas, a tray, a tealight holder) confirming no real Eid category. No Halloween/Diwali/Easter/Valentine/Thanksgiving/New Year presence found in nav or homepage content either. Conclusion: this UAE home-decor retailer's actual site taxonomy contains no genuine seasonal/holiday PLP category (Christmas, Halloween, Diwali, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, Eid, or Ramadan) at time of extraction (2026-09-04); a small number of individual products carry seasonal names/descriptions but are not organized under any seasonal category page, so per the boundary rules no rows are created.
